monochrome.flavour_en:
"You cannot portray the world using just one colour. Together, you and I, we will paint our world into perfection."
- Kyra, renegade thaumaturgist

burning blood.flavour_en:
There's a place where up is down,
where right is wrong,
where pleasure is agony,
and where the living wish only for death.

the fox.flavour_en:
"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb

the catch.flavour_en: The largest hooks offer the greatest catch, but often the catch is the hook.

the thaumaturgist.flavour_en:
"Mastery of thaumaturgy is like any other pursuit; it requires dedication and sacrifice. Sometimes several sacrifices."
- Shavronne of Umbra

the jester.flavour_en:
Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.

when currents blaze.flavour_en:
In their fiery union,
the storm left the rivers
forever changed.

sambodhi's wisdom.flavour_en:
No blade conquers sin;
guide a sinner to virtue,
unveil their lost sight—
your eyes, too, see in
everyone the inner child,
no matter their might.

alone in the darkness.flavour_en:
"Sometimes, the most beautiful treasures...are the ones you cannot have."
- Beryl, Survivor from the Azurite Mines

a familiar call.flavour_en:
The mighty huntress always called for her share,
But what we shared was a lifelong bond.

harmony of souls.flavour_en:
Shrieking souls locked away
Hate splits frozen cells asunder
The knot of corruption
undone at last

the transformation.flavour_en: Even the most beautiful of transformations can still have a dark side.

the dragon's heart.flavour_en: They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.

rebirth and renewal.flavour_en: Life has an end, then life begins again.

brother's gift.flavour_en:
Even though his flame has burned out,
he will never fade away.

the ruthless ceinture.flavour_en:
In combat, a warrior must first be resourceful,
and second, decisive.

thunderous skies.flavour_en: Many that have wielded the power of lightning have said that death by electrocution looks like the victim is more alive than ever before.

the mad king.flavour_en: Fear the man who lusts for power, for he will do anything to get it.

the price of prescience.flavour_en: The strange voice showed Aul a future where his legacy was forgotten, where new cultures broke themselves upon Aul's ruined world.

the standoff.flavour_en: Sometimes your greatest enemy is the only one keeping you breathing.

the fishmonger.flavour_en: However vicious Rhoas might be, a dedicated angler may in time tame them.

the realm.flavour_en: If you wish to rush into strange places, be prepared to face strange things.

the saint's treasure.flavour_en: Publicly, he lived a pious and chaste life of poverty. Privately, tithes and tributes made him and his lascivious company very comfortable indeed.

the traitor.flavour_en:
Sometimes an apprentice becomes a master through countless hours of hard work and practice.
Sometimes it happens by force.

unrequited love.flavour_en:
The pale flame of his heart disappeared in his azure reflection.
The work of a life.
Ambitious, and unfinished.

the lake.flavour_en:
Gaze upon the Lake
Gaze upon your Reflection
Your full Potential

grave knowledge.flavour_en: The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.

the escape.flavour_en: In fleeing reality, you step into the realm of madness.

the harvester.flavour_en:
Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.

the pack leader.flavour_en: Become the leader you were born to be.

void of the elements.flavour_en: Though the forces of nature are mighty and intimidating, it is their absence which should be feared.

imperfect memories.flavour_en: Everything is eroded by time, but sometimes the edges that fade can make a wonderful memory even more beautiful.

blessing of god.flavour_en: When the darkness weighs upon you, grow light from within.

lucky deck.flavour_en: When the outcome is the same, does it matter if it is fortune or trickery?

arrogance of the vaal.flavour_en: Discovery can lead to beauty, or it can lead to ruin.

deadly joy.flavour_en:
"Be fast. That is all that matters."
- Rita of the Asylum

the lion.flavour_en: The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.

the slumbering beast.flavour_en:
He slumbers...
But soon he will awaken.

gift of asenath.flavour_en: The Golden Sekhema's words could solve many a feud. Just what form that solution took was another matter.

the metalsmith's gift.flavour_en: A month's work, a year's wages, a foolish shortcut through a Rhoa's nest, and a grieving bride-to-be, who never received her betrothed's great gift.

the trial.flavour_en: You cannot journey to new lands until you have the courage to leave the safety of home.

history.flavour_en:
The future is oft-foretold
in records of the past.

the explorer.flavour_en: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.

the mind's eyes.flavour_en:
Through the eyes of a person,
you can see their soul
Through the eyes of a jewel,
you can see the universe

the side quest.flavour_en: You'll never know the things you miss if you keep your eyes closed

dying light.flavour_en: Even the brightest eventually fade to darkness.

the aspirant.flavour_en:
Those Exiles that survive Wraeclast
dream not of home, but of power.

the twilight moon.flavour_en: The day is dying, the night is born, the air grows cool, the sky is torn.

luminous trove.flavour_en:
Plenty enter, dreaming of treasure
Twenty bled, slain as they fled
Shadows loom, half left doomed
The blind cries, five lost eyes
Careless twins, a lich's new prize
One as a decoy, none pass the king
Gehennix feeds only on whispers

akil's prophecy.flavour_en:
The hatungo know many answers to the same question,
for time itself is a tangled web.

the eye of the dragon.flavour_en:
Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.

magnum opus.flavour_en: Wraeclast will unite. This shall be my great work - the minds of the people made one.

the samurai's eye.flavour_en: At night, when the seas are calm, and the skies dark, he can see it. The formless fiend that took his eye, and fractured his mind.

alluring bounty.flavour_en:
A treasure worth killing for
is a treasure worth dying for.

the poet.flavour_en:
God had forsaken the land
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land
And Victario's tears turned to blood.

echoes of love.flavour_en: "I gave up my body for you. I gave up my name for you. And one day I shall give up my life for you."

assassin's gift.flavour_en:
What matters are
the Marks of your life,
not its Longevity.

the astromancer.flavour_en:
They would say that he was a dangerous man,
unbound by the sense of morality,
but what does this matter,
when his love for humanity is undeniable
and completion of his work would benefit everyone?

sambodhi's vow.flavour_en:
He dispels dark realms
until mortal sufferings
yield to hopeful light.

the forsaken.flavour_en: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.

the artist.flavour_en: "Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless

the obscured.flavour_en: Our world, dangerous as it is, is far safer than what lies just beyond our sight.

lethean temptation.flavour_en: My memories tortured me without end. To escape them, I embraced nothingness, but oblivion simply brought a different kind of pain...

underground forest.flavour_en: "In the forest again... But at least I have these."

brush, paint and palette.flavour_en: "Man may shape the world, but these? These shape the man." -Inquisitor Maligaro

the encroaching darkness.flavour_en: No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.

succor of the sinless.flavour_en: Blessed is the blood of the beholden disciple. The earth is anointed by his step. The damnable are sanctified by his strike.

the cache.flavour_en:
Vintage or crafted, Glittering and shiny
Dusty or glittering, huge or tiny
Secured within a chest
or unearthed from your mining
Find jewellery everywhere,
no need for divining!
So why is it so hard
to figure out which one to wear?
This one makes me stronger,
but does it match my hair?

the deal.flavour_en: In the pursuit of wealth, as in that of power, anything goes.

hunter's reward.flavour_en: To tame a beast, you first must subdue its heart.

the master.flavour_en: In a world filled with chaos, he could always seek comfort in the hands of his master.

parasitic passengers.flavour_en: Feeding on death, they grew stronger and stronger, until they were ready to hatch...

matryoshka.flavour_en:
I cannot contain myself,
but I can barely squeak,
so many words I'd have for you,
if I could only speak!

thirst for knowledge.flavour_en:
A ravenous mind can readily take in ideas from any source.
Fortunately for the scholars, he has already learned about sustainability.

darker half.flavour_en: When you find what you're looking for, it's never quite right. When you have what you desire, yet you still want more.

the road to power.flavour_en: A beacon on the horizon; a guiding light, a call for help, or a warning to turn back.

the jeweller's boon.flavour_en: The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.

the lord of celebration.flavour_en: Though they were a pack of elite combatants, the Emperor's royal guards were not ready to face one of his notorious parties.

the last supper.flavour_en: "Bino's brief career as a chef at Axiom saved the executioner a lot of work."

the hermit.flavour_en: The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.

the blessing of moosh.flavour_en: While the Labyrinth traps have claimed countless adventurers, they were not designed with felines in mind.

the fiend.flavour_en:
Your era is now,
your power unwavered,
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.

the wedding gift.flavour_en: The acolytes congratulated the lucky groom for becoming one with the goddess.

the forbidden fruit.flavour_en:
It's about working smarter,
not harder.

the whiteout.flavour_en:
They thought winter had come early,
that snow blanketed the land,
but in truth, all their chickens
had come home to roost.

divine justice.flavour_en: Many sought the Goddess' blessing. Few survived the Labyrinth to receive it.

doryani's epiphany.flavour_en: "Virtue gems have facets beyond those that can be seen by the mortal eye. Let us look deeper..."

remembrance.flavour_en:
"For all your struggles, all your achievements, even for the greatest of us, a story is all that remains. Write it well."
-Julius Perandus, Father of Chitus

the gulf.flavour_en:
I thought love stronger than all,
but time and isolation broke
that which madness could not.

the lunaris priestess.flavour_en:
Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.

the porcupine.flavour_en: The first quill separates the quick learners from the dead.

the everlasting.flavour_en:
The Atlas invites us all
to a lifelong journey.
It would be unwise
to overstay our welcome.

outfoxed.flavour_en:
The prize vanished.
No trail, no struggle.
Just a single, rust-red hair.

the web.flavour_en:
A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.

the eldritch decay.flavour_en: Time dismantles all things eventually, but some wish to accelerate the process.

chasing risk.flavour_en: A fond memory fills me with nostalgia; some men would have felt guilt, but I felt no regret over the anguish and fear my ambitions caused.

the card sharp.flavour_en: "The house always wins... except when I do."

the insane cat.flavour_en: One person's madness is another person's reality.

house of mirrors.flavour_en: What do you see in the mirror?

the penitent.flavour_en: First, I gave my wealth, and we went hungry. Next, I gave my land, and we were homeless. Then, I gave my family, and I was alone. Last, I gave my eyes, and all I could dream was mine.

the primordial.flavour_en:
We play at God with our necromancy,
but forces far more potent
sleep within these stones.

the emptiness.flavour_en: He appeared before the Light Eater, and at once knew his soul was damned.

altered perception.flavour_en: You mustn't forget: you won't be leaving this place.

dark dreams.flavour_en: No one ever truly understood what she meant when she said she wanted to raise a family.

the doppelganger.flavour_en: Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!

lost worlds.flavour_en:
"There are worlds that lie beyond the edge of my page, the edge of my understanding. Worlds of wonder. Worlds of terror."
Aramil - Cartographer to Emperor Chitus

lonely warrior.flavour_en:
A true warrior fights
for those who cannot
fight for themselves.

the journey.flavour_en: Oh the places you will go, the sights you will see, the things you will meet.

the hoarder.flavour_en: "More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable

the flora's gift.flavour_en:
Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.

the sigil.flavour_en:
Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.

the wilted rose.flavour_en: Though the path to divinity is fraught with peril, hope may bloom from within.

the apothecary.flavour_en: "You seek the power of my strongest potions, but the price will be far higher than you can imagine."

brotherhood in exile.flavour_en:
Seeking shelter from the night,
in the warmth of the run-down inn,
erstwhile foes put aside the fight,
to bond over whiskey and gin.

the prince of darkness.flavour_en: Fear a man who is willing to sacrifice anything for power.

the shieldbearer.flavour_en: While you grow, I shall be your knight, and you my squire. One day, you shall be the one who stands and defends our home.

doedre's madness.flavour_en: "Hold your tongue before I claim it." - Doedre Darktongue

from bone to ashes.flavour_en: For centuries, they stood vigil in secret over their sleeping goddess, even as contamination oozed out of the decadent Vaal empire.

emperor of purity.flavour_en:
True to his title,
Voll, newly crowned,
had many of the
Eternal Empire's signature
extravagances destroyed.

the wolf.flavour_en: The largest beasts cannot be overpowered. The Greatwolf teaches us to use guile, not strength, to probe for the soft flesh and strike deep.

home.flavour_en:
There are countless people,
countless stories,
and countless eras,
but there is one place that,
for a time, each of us loved
and was loved. It matters.
We matter.

the silly boy.flavour_en:
From silly pondering
comes legend,
and from legend,
horned fortune

the old man.flavour_en: Hear me, fish! I love and respect you, but before this day ends I will kill you dead.

the warlord.flavour_en:
To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.

the gladiator.flavour_en:
The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars,
they want death
and the blood is yours.

haunting shadows.flavour_en:
In the dead of night you may elude your shadows,
but they will always find you by dawn.

lucky bastion.flavour_en:
Discipline forged our unbreakable Rampart.
Bastion against Despair.

the incantation.flavour_en: When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.

the bones.flavour_en: The flesh is a prison, and we are finally free.

the soul.flavour_en: "Most people only have one. I'm a bit of a hoarder."

the sun.flavour_en: Each night, the light dies, and each morning she is born anew, embracing the land in her golden wings.

the aesthete.flavour_en:
"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra

the academic.flavour_en:
"Such dedication for so many years,
all for a couple extra letters at the front of your name..."

desperate crusade.flavour_en: Through despondent hardships, those strong of spirit shall claim the prize.

the puzzle.flavour_en: As countless fractures weaken the divide, nightmares seep through from the other side.

rebirth.flavour_en:
He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh

the hive of knowledge.flavour_en: Within years of knowledge, distilled by careful craftsmanship, lies great power.

the avenger.flavour_en:
Justice comes swift
Equal to the crime
Revenge is a gift
Life for a life
Eye for an eye

destined to crumble.flavour_en:
"Let us not forget the most important lesson the Vaal taught us:
Nothing is eternal."
- Siosa Foaga, Imperial Scholar

the brittle emperor.flavour_en:
"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet

the wolven king's bite.flavour_en: A wolf does not bite his mate as he does his prey, yet both begin with bared teeth. Know who you are, and you will know the meaning of the bite.

the enthusiasts.flavour_en:
"Glimmers of benevolence,
Shrouded a lacquered lust for power,
Yet still they followed his influence."

prosperity.flavour_en: Accumulating wealth has its own costs.

the opulent.flavour_en: Wealth can, in fact, buy happiness.

the bitter blossom.flavour_en: The pain you feel is of no consequence, it is evolution, to be made whole within something greater.

energy sword.flavour_en:
To my number one fan.
- Griffin, with love

the chosen.flavour_en: They whose lives were given to clothe the Dark Dreamer... They were the lucky ones.

boundless realms.flavour_en: Boundless is the distance between where we start and where we start again.

earth drinker.flavour_en: Taste and grow strong. Drink too much and be buried.

the one that got away.flavour_en:
Savor life's missing pieces.
To complete one's final goal
is to take one's last breath.

the fox in the brambles.flavour_en: Hemmingsworth 6:10 - "And the fox gazed out from the brambles, unreachable and smirking."

prejudice.flavour_en: One who is blinded by their past may only see a sliver of the present.

immortal resolve.flavour_en: The threads of fate are the strongest ties.

treasure hunter.flavour_en:
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
- Toggo's Last Words

the fletcher.flavour_en: Let these fine arrows pack a punch.

the offspring.flavour_en: The swarm began with just a couple of children. Now, it is her entire existence.

the mountain.flavour_en:
Charmed by beautiful stones
Consumed with the
pursuit of perfection
Ever deeper into the waiting dark

the chains that bind.flavour_en: Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.

the last one standing.flavour_en: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.

the dapper prodigy.flavour_en: "Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."

the hook.flavour_en: Every obsession began with a single, innocent taste.

imperial legacy.flavour_en: A life lost, A legacy born.

choking guilt.flavour_en: As death approached, clarity eluded him. The pain he had wrought surrounded him, dragging him into darkness.

reckless ambition.flavour_en: Why settle when more is never enough.

the survivalist.flavour_en:
A lucky number
For us all
To help us through
The perils told.

the wrath.flavour_en: "Daughter of catastrophe, mother of pain. Amongst the filth of Wraeclast, she wanders, and her wrath follows." - Quintoon the Returned

dark temptation.flavour_en:
"Only a fool looks to the occult for power and expects to be spared from its wrath."
- Voll, Emperor of Purity

avian pursuit.flavour_en:
Blazing through the night
Longing for infinite flight
Awaiting dawn's first light

the breach.flavour_en: Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?

the progeny of lunaris.flavour_en:
Born beneath silver light, bearing Lunaris' mark.
Conjuring all his might, the Prodigy turned light to dark.

the dragon.flavour_en:
Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.

the dreamland.flavour_en: All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.

the nurse.flavour_en: We tried to tell him to get his head checked.

the dreamer.flavour_en:
A dark note drips
from the dreamer's lips,
A honeyed melody.
We stand, we fall
on his beck and call,
for in his dream we're free.

abandoned wealth.flavour_en: When the world burned, the greedy burned with it, while the clever left as paupers.

the scarred meadow.flavour_en: The earth offers nourishment, growth and healing. Unless, of course, the sky has other plans.

perfection.flavour_en: There are countless worlds, but only those with limitless potential will be able to achieve perfection.

poisoned faith.flavour_en: Even our most devout beliefs are subtly shaped by our darkest desires.

misery in darkness.flavour_en:
He wandered the bone-filled depths hoping each corner would be his last.
Eventually, he found Light.

her mask.flavour_en:
To her beauty you submit,
lest your neck the great Queen slit.

time-lost relic.flavour_en: Time cannot wash away that which cannot be forgotten.

the journalist.flavour_en: A good spy doesn't forget she's gone undercover.

death.flavour_en:
The end of the old,
the beginning of the new.
A unique opportunity for transformation,
for those with the power
to grasp it.

the enlightened.flavour_en:
Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.

The suit I wear,
Is heavy and bare.
A canvas, it seems, breathing life into dreams.

divine shard.flavour_en:
Sin sought to contain Divinity
so that no mortal would gain
such monstrous power ever again.

broken truce.flavour_en: With a single act, years of peace have been shattered. An unknown assassin brings war upon us all.

cameria's cut.flavour_en:
"There are two ways to pay, Gold and Blood. I'll take my share in both."
-Cameria the Coldblooded

the seeker.flavour_en: All that is flawed is worthless. The slightest error, and this might as well be trash.

the dungeon master.reward_ru:
Пояс
Уникальный предмет с двумя влияниями
the dungeon master.flavour_en: "So desperate was I for control, I turned my entire world into a prison. Now you will share in my agony."

broken promises.flavour_en: Experience teaches us that the cold is not the same as the absence of warmth.

the bear woman.flavour_en:
For the blessed bear in the cave,
A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,
until moon begins its fourth passage,
the bear sheds her beastly fur,
and is reborn, human and whole.

one last score.flavour_en:
You want to know how
I haven't been caught?
It's not just speed.
You need some luck.

a stone perfected.flavour_en: They gave the stone life. Over eons spent bathed in Corruption, that life evolved.

the beast.flavour_en: To know the monster, you must become the monster.

the rite of elements.flavour_en:
A mind as quick as lightning,
fists as hard as stone,
a heart that burns with fury,
and eyes that chill to the bone.

the warden.flavour_en: Brutus' first innovation as Lord Incarcerator was a weighted chain around every neck so that his prisoners would forever bow to him.

the lover.flavour_en: "I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."

i see brothers.flavour_en:
"Where does the light go
when it is dark?"

Eyes of the Greatwolf
Item Level: 82
Corrupted
apocalypse.reward_ru:

apocalypse.flavour_en:
The Ezomytes,
buried beneath flaming mountains
by the First Ones.
The Vaal,
undone by a cataclysm
of their own making.
Are all empires fated to fall to hubris?

chaotic disposition.flavour_en: Life isn't what you make of it, it's already been made for you.

squandered prosperity.flavour_en: "Our rulers are being ridiculous, and we are suffering."

the scholar.flavour_en: It is with the smallest of words that we find the largest of truths.

divine beauty.flavour_en:
In a land far away lived
a maiden most fair.
Her smile melted the coldest
of hearts, her song made
men and beast cry,
her beauty unparalleled;
Divine.

the damned.flavour_en:
Souls along a conduit of blood,
from one vessel to the next.

the sephirot.flavour_en: If the path to divinity were simple, we'd all be gods.

bound by flame.flavour_en:
In battle we burn together
or not at all.

the witch.flavour_en:
A wanderer in the wild strives
Against countless foes he survives
A fool pursues a quest contrived
By the gift of the witch, alive.

pride of the first ones.flavour_en:
Upon silent paws and masked by the reeds,
Farrul's hunt begins as the light recedes.

heterochromia.flavour_en:
Black and White, Silver and Gold
Let us see the world Unfold
Red and Blue, Yellow and Green
Let us remake it in colours Unseen

the lich.flavour_en: When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.

eldritch perfection.reward_en:
Item Level: 100
Perfect Eldritch Implicit Modifier
eldritch perfection.reward_ru:
Уровень предмета: 100
Perfect Eldritch Implicit Modifier
eldritch perfection.flavour_en:
Embrace horror.
Bathe in its beauty.

dementophobia.flavour_en:
I never truly understood the depths of my insanity,
until I realized the voices beckoning me towards the abyss,
were none other than my own.

wealth and power.flavour_en: The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.

left to fate.flavour_en:
Many strive for greatness,
but it is challenge, unforeseen,
that forges heroes.

coveted possession.flavour_en: A taste of power brings a hunger for more.

jack in the box.flavour_en:
Turn the crank,
close your eyes,
and pray to the gods
for a pleasant surprise.

Quality: +23%
Corrupted

terrible secret of space.flavour_en: They said they were here to protect us.

the insatiable.flavour_en: A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.

the valkyrie.flavour_en:
The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.
- Drake's Epitaph

lingering remnants.flavour_en:
Never dying, yet not living,
Endlessly they wander
beneath the harvest moon.

the watcher.flavour_en:
Strange eyes on top of spines
Gaze beyond the veil of time
Deep down below the mines
A dream of crimson and of grime

the cartographer.flavour_en:
My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.

the wind.flavour_en: Weaving through the cracks, searching for weaknesses, silent, indiscriminate, leaving sorrow in its wake.

gift of the gemling queen.flavour_en:
Our Lady Dialla,
as a symbol of our progress,
shines greater than all the gems.

rats.flavour_en: Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.

council of cats.flavour_en:
A King Loved By All,
A Shadow Awaiting Nightfall,
A Speaker Howling Away,
A Hunter Seeking Prey

the spark and the flame.flavour_en: When sky meets ground the flames can be found, but who has the will to tame them.

the surveyor.flavour_en: Exploring lands made of flesh and sorrow, we'll reap and plunder like there's no tomorrow.

Level 4 Exceptional Support Gem
Quality: +23%
Corrupted

desecrated virtue.flavour_en:
Awoken virtuous slivers of the void,
defiled by the avaricious,
seized by the tyrannical.

checkmate.flavour_en: When victory is impossible, each of us plays only to delay the end.

the endurance.flavour_en:
Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.

the shortcut.reward_en:
Quicksilver Flask of the Cheetah
Item Level: 100
the shortcut.reward_ru:
Quicksilver Flask of the Cheetah
Уровень предмета: 100
the shortcut.flavour_en: If time is the most valuable currency, how do you make more of it?

pride before the fall.flavour_en:
As Kaom slew the last of his kin,
something deep inside him broke.
And through the cracks, corruption,
pure and black, spread forth.

blind venture.flavour_en:
"It's risky not knowing where your wares come from. That's why I source my own."
- Klayver, the Antiquarian

the blazing fire.flavour_en: Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.

man with bear.flavour_en: A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.

the deceiver.flavour_en: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.

the craving.flavour_en: What was once a passing thought tickling the back of the mind is now a desperate, driving desire.

the offering.flavour_en: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.

the union.flavour_en:
On the 21st of Eterni,
two become one,
their light outshines
the setting sun.

the bargain.flavour_en: In the pursuit of power, as in that of wealth, anything goes.

boon of the first ones.flavour_en:
Wreathed in the skin and bones
of the beasts she slew,
her gift came from what she lost:
her humanity.

ever-changing.flavour_en: The Atlas is our prison, and our only defence. She is our only hope, and our certain doom.

the brawny battle mage.flavour_en: A humble piece of wood offers the simplest solution to life's problems: just hit them really, really hard.

three voices.flavour_en: The village elders had a curious rule: If you hear three voices scream for aid, flee as fast as you can.

duality.reward_en:
Body Armour
Item Level: 100
Double-Influenced Item
duality.reward_ru:
Нательный доспех
Уровень предмета: 100
Уникальный предмет с двумя влияниями
duality.flavour_en: Good and Evil can be woven together to become something greater than either.

Elder Item

the undisputed.flavour_en: To create something truly spectacular, you must risk total failure.

temperance.flavour_en:
Good things come
to those who wait;
but, greatness seeks
those who do not come.

the last laugh.flavour_en:
Holding fast when shadows fall,
Over ruins, jesters call.
Nothing breaks their twisted cheer,
Kings of chaos, friends sincere.

runic luck.flavour_en:
If you believe hard enough,
you'll win.

unchained.flavour_en: Mold the world with your bare hands. Be careful, for what is your doing might become your undoing.

energised armour.flavour_en: "I've yet to see prayer stop an arrow."

fertile mind.flavour_en: "The swallow flew fast and took many turns, spilling a seed where no plant had grown before. This seed grew and grew until the desert became fertile and abundant. Your mind is like this seed." - Maraketh Proverb

fevered mind.flavour_en: In sickness, the insane becomes sane.

fluid motion.flavour_en: Even the strongest of steel can be made to bend.

hidden potential.flavour_en: The difference between the master and his apprentice is what they see when they look at the same block of wood.

inertia.flavour_en: There is no force without movement.

reckless defence.flavour_en: There's no motivation for genius quite like desperation.

to dust.flavour_en: In the end, time comes for all of us. For some, it comes much sooner.

the golden rule.flavour_en: Hurt as you would be hurt.
